description: Restores a saved model or a run you deleted with delete_graph or delete_run, putting it back exactly as it was. Use this when the user wants back something they deleted, within 30 days of deleting it; find its kind and id with list_deleted. Restoring a model brings back the runs that were deleted with it, and their share links work again. A run whose model is still deleted cannot be restored on its own (parent_deleted): restore the model first. After the 30 days it is refused with restore_window_expired and the item cannot be recovered. Restoring something that is not deleted changes nothing. It returns the kind, the id and when it was restored. It needs a Neumann account: send your key, or your signed-in token, in the Authorization header as a Bearer credential. No Neumann tool takes an api_key argument. Example: {"kind":"graph","id":"8f3c2a"} Cost: free -- it debits no credits and spends none of your free daily runs -- but it needs an account; an anonymous caller gets account_required.
